t.Soil is alive. A handful of healthy soil: Ƙasa tana raye. Kadan na ƙasa mai lafiya yana ɗauke da tsutsotsin ƙasa, tururuwa, fungi da biliyoyin ƙwayoyin cuta. Wasu kwayoyin cuta, da ake kira rhizobia, suna rayuwa ne a cikin kananan dunƙule (nodules) a kan tushen legumes irin su saniya, gyada da waken soya, kuma suna juya nitrogen daga iska zuwa wani nau'i na tsire-tsire. Fungi yana yada zaren bakin ciki wanda ke taimakawa tushen isa ga ruwa da phosphorus. Lokacin da kuke ciyarwa da kare wannan ma'aikatan karkashin kasa, yana aiki a gare ku kyauta.
t.Sustainable farming also looks beyond th: Noma mai dorewa kuma yana kallon bayan ƙasa. A wata ƙaramar gona waɗannan manufofin galibi suna nuni iri ɗaya: ƙasa mai rufe, ƙasa mai rai tana ɗaukar ruwan sama, tana tsiro da tsire-tsire masu ƙarfi kuma tana buƙatar ƙarancin ceto.

t.Most Nigerian farming is rain-fed, so th: Yawancin noman Najeriya ana samun ruwan sama ne, don haka farkon (farawa), ƙarewa (katsewa) da tsawon lokacin damina ne ke yanke shawarar irin nau'in da za a gama kafin ƙasa ta bushe. t.Compost is plant and animal waste that s: Takin sharar tsiro ne da na dabba wanda kwayoyin ƙasa suka wargaje zuwa wani abu mai duhu.
